title: Fix ZapVsForemanRace: race animation is broken
description: Effect has phase in deps which causes cleanup to cancel RAF. User reports both columns static. Fix: remove phase from deps, use only inView as trigger.
close_reason: Removed phase from effect deps; use runKey for replay trigger. RAF no longer cancelled by phase-induced re-renders.

title: Landing copy: rewrite PII + BYOZ sections
description: PII redaction copy is technical and has a wrong framing (model never sees data — actually we redact model OUTPUT). Rewrite in plain English. BYOZ: 'Bring your own Zapier' implies there's an alternative; we never supply a Zapier account. Reframe as 'Connect your Zapier in one click' — stays factual.
close_reason: PII copy rewritten plain — 'Personal details get hidden before you see them'. BYOZ reframed as 'Uses the Zapier account you already have' — no longer implies we have an alternative to offer.

title: Guardrails: put demo inline in the tapped card on mobile
description: Current mobile behavior auto-scrolls to a separate panel above the cards. User wants the demo to live inside the tapped card itself (accordion pattern) so the result appears in place. Keep side-panel layout on desktop.
close_reason: Mobile accordion: tapped card expands inline with its demo. Desktop keeps two-column sticky panel.

title: Landing copy pass: drop Recommended, rewrite tech jargon
description: Remove Recommended badge from Self-host card. Rewrite ToolDiscovery intro — sounds like a README. Make it benefit-first plain English.
close_reason: More prompts, more varied matches. Copy rewritten in plain English, Recommended badge removed.

title: Fix Guardrails mobile: demo panel hidden on click
description: On mobile clicking a card puts demo far below. Auto-scroll demo into view on selection, or inline render on mobile.
close_reason: Auto-scroll demo panel into view on mobile tap. Also reordered so demo appears above cards on mobile (order-1/order-2).

title: Enhance ChannelMemory: mini chat UIs per channel
description: Upgrade channel nodes to mini chat windows with brand color + message bubbles appearing inside.
close_reason: Channels now render as mini chat UIs with brand colors and actual message bubbles appearing inside on flow. Added flowing particle through the brain.

title: Enhance ToolDiscovery: more prompts and matches
description: Feels thin — expand to 6+ prompts, 3-5 varied matches each.
close_reason: More prompts, more varied matches. Copy rewritten in plain English, Recommended badge removed.

title: Landing page: mobile/tablet/desktop responsive audit and polish
description:
Audit and tighten responsive behavior across the landing page and app so it feels native from a 320px phone up to 4K displays.

Scope:
- / (landing)
- /chat
- /workflows
- /workflows/[id]

Device targets (researched 2026 standards — Framer, Tailwind v4 defaults):
- Mobile portrait: 320-480px (iPhone SE through 14 Pro Max)
- Mobile landscape / small tablet: 481-768px
- Tablet: 769-1024px (iPad portrait)
- Small desktop: 1025-1280px
- Desktop: 1281-1536px
- Large desktop: 1537px+

Known landing page issues:
1. Hero grid gap-16 too large on narrow viewports — use gap-8 md:gap-16
2. FiveThings table grid-cols-[1fr_1.3fr] crammed on 320px — stack vertically
3. Hero demo Row component truncates on narrow screens
4. text-lg body copy borderline on 320px — use text-base sm:text-lg
5. py-24 section padding heavy on mobile — use py-16 sm:py-24
6. Channels grid — Google Chat description triple-wraps at 160px
7. Footer gap-5 links wrap awkwardly on small screens
8. No container queries used — add for hero demo and hosting cards
9. Test at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536 in DevTools

Acceptance:
- No horizontal scroll at any target width
- Tap targets >=44px (iOS HIG)
- Body text >=16px without zoom
- No content clipping or overlap
- Tested in light and dark mode
- Verified on real iOS Safari and Android Chrome
